# Contributing

How to contribute to the Wiki Platform. Note that this is the **proxy
repository** ([README](./README.md)) — the implementation lives in the
private core, so contributions here work differently from a normal repo.

## What you can do here

- **Corrections** — open an issue-style email with a page link, a
  screenshot, and expected vs. actual text.
- **Translations** — native-speaker review of any of the 8 locale
  dictionaries, one at a time.
- **New languages** — propose a language with its native name and a sample
  paragraph.
- **Features** — describe the reader problem first, the solution second.
- **Docs in this repo** — typo fixes and clarifications to the markdown
  surface (`README.md`, `docs/`, `.github/COLLABORATORS.md`, `.github/SECURITY.md`) are
  welcome as pull requests.

## How to propose

1. Email [dev@lingadevaru.in](mailto:dev@lingadevaru.in) with the subject
   `Wiki Platform: <topic>`, naming which language site it concerns.
2. Useful, well-described proposals may be granted access to the relevant
   core source — just ask, and include what you'd contribute and why.
3. Agreed changes are implemented in the core, deployed to all eight
   sites, and recorded here as a release note.

## Ground rules

- Be kind and specific; no spam.
- Never include credentials, tokens, or private data (see
  [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md)).
- No scraping the sites — dictionaries are human-reviewed work.
- Response time: best effort, evenings IST.
